code_discovery.scan_notes: A strong shared principal/context spine already exists: company_id, actor/user, roles, capabilities, surface/device/conversation/journey and trace lineage are represented across Interaction Engine, Interface Runtime, Autonomy and Merge80. However no active oauth-named artifact or one explicit Titan OAuth context contract was found in Merge80. apps/web auth/session.ts uses accountId while the canonical runtime uses company_id, and vertical context is not uniformly bound into the authenticated principal. Converge these seams explicitly; do not create a parallel tenant boundary.

code_discovery.scan_notes: Strong authority-contraction primitives already exist: delegated authority expires and becomes extinct when parents are suspended/revoked/expired; lease control prevents authority increase, expiry extension and revival after revocation; offline authorization contracts on stale/revoked authority; Autonomy issues short-lived signed delegated envelopes tied to company, capability, workflow, user/session/interaction/correlation. Main implementation is to bind these primitives to every surface/session transition so stale sessions cannot carry delegated authority across Command/Go/Hub changes.
